children.text: pañcakās tv aṣṭa vijñeyā gaṇaś caikas trikātmakaḥ
children.translated_text: The pentads should be known to be eight, and there is one group consisting of a triad.
The knower of these nine groups, who performs consecration, is called the teacher.
The attainments, impurities, means, places, states, and purifications,
the factors effecting initiation, and the powers are the eight pentads; the modes of conduct are three.

children.text: gurubhaktiḥ prasādaś ca mater dvaṃdvajayas tathā
children.translated_text: Devotion to the teacher, grace, and the mind's conquest of the pairs of opposites,

children.text: dharmaś caivāpramādaś ca balaṃ pañcavidhaṃ smṛtam ||
children.translated_text: as well as <s>dharma</s> (righteous order) and vigilance: power is remembered as fivefold.
The removal of ignorance, the removal of <s>adharma</s> (unrighteousness), and the removal of that which causes attachment,
the removal of falling away, and purification from <s>paśutva</s> (the condition of a bound soul): purification is remembered as fivefold.
The manifest, the unmanifest, victory, severance, and steadfastness as the fifth are taught here.

children.text: dravyaṃ kālaḥ kriyā mūrtir guruś caiveha pañcamaḥ ||
children.translated_text: The five factors here are substance, time, action, form, and the teacher as the fifth.

children.text: jñānaṃ tapo 'tha nityatvaṃ sthitiḥ siddhiś ca pañcamī
children.translated_text: The attainments are knowledge, austerity, permanence, stability, and perfection as the fifth.
The teacher, a populated place, a cave, the cremation ground, and <s>Rudra</s> himself are the five places.
Residence, observance, meditation through recitation, and constant recollection of <s>Rudra</s>,
and grace itself: these five are definitively the means to the attainments.
False knowledge, <s>adharma</s> (unrighteousness), the cause of attachment, and falling away,
and <s>paśutva</s> (the condition of a bound soul), the root: in this <s>tantra</s> (teaching), these five come under the heading of what must be abandoned.
